faq.q: What does Monday Marketing Company do?
faq.a: Monday Marketing Company is an India-based growth partner. One senior team runs paid media, creative, retention, search and websites together for D2C brands, B2B companies and educational institutes, and judges the work on profit and qualified enquiries rather than on platform-reported vanity numbers.

D2C brands are our deepest story: Meta, Google, Amazon, quick commerce and Shopify, judged on contribution margin. We also work with B2B companies that need qualified leads over longer buying cycles, and with schools, colleges and institutes that need enquiries turned into admissions. See our education marketing and college admission marketing pages.

faq.q: How is MMC different from other agencies?
faq.a: We start from unit economics, not from ad accounts. In week one we build the model: contribution margin, break-even ROAS and CAC ceiling. Creative, media and site changes then ship together, because they only work together, and we are measured on staying, not on a launch.

faq.q: What happens in the free audit?
faq.a: A senior strategist reads your account, funnel and cost sheet: break-even economics, account structure, tracking and creative. You leave knowing which system to fix first. It is a read of your numbers, not a sales presentation, and if we are not the right fit, we say so.

Against contribution margin for D2C, and against qualified leads and admissions for B2B and education. Optimisation runs weekly against contribution and monthly against the P&L. You can test your own numbers first with our free calculators for break-even ROAS, CAC runway and LTV to CAC.

faq.q: Which platforms and tools do you run?
faq.a: Media on Meta, Google, Amazon, YouTube, TikTok and LinkedIn. Quick commerce on Blinkit, Zepto and Instamart. Stores on Shopify with GoKwik, Shopflo and Razorpay checkout. Retention on Klaviyo, MoEngage and WhatsApp. Measurement in GA4, Tableau, Adobe and Mixpanel, set up and run by one team.

faq.q: How long before the engine is working?
faq.a: The plan has three stages. Week one is the read of the account and the unit-economics model. Weeks two to four are when creative, media and site changes go live together. From month two we compound with weekly and monthly optimisation. We do not promise results before we have seen your numbers.

Book a strategy call with a senior strategist, or send us your name, work email, website and what you sell using the form on this page. We will read your numbers and tell you the first things to fix. There is no deck and no pitch in the first conversation.
